Contract CoCoMESystem::openStore(storeID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		s: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = storeID)
	precondition:
		s.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		s.IsOpened = false
	postcondition:
		s.IsOpened = true and
		self.CurrentStore = s and
		result = true
}
